pageCache.text: Triangle Nursery School will be temporarily relocating to the site of Effra Nursery School as of 1st January 2024.For Clapham Manor Children’s Centre at Triangle click here. The space and facilities at Effra are vast and we are excited about how this move will benefit both schools and what we can provide for children and families. We can use this opportunity to combine two of our schools on one site and bring together two teams of dedicated and experienced practitioners to support children and families.Emily Patterson will be the Head of School for both Effra and Triangle Nursery Schools and coordinate a smooth transition for all children, families and staff. If you have any questions, please click here.To apply for a place click here or call the school on 020 7733 8425 to arrange a parent tour and secure a place for your child.
